precepts.text: A mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone, and cast it into the sea, saying, Thus with violence shall that great city Babylon be thrown down. Thy merchants were the great men of the earth: their corporations. For by thy sorceries were all nations deceived: the imagery, the television, the movies that manipulate the people, like the discussion earlier about images and enrollment. And do not think there are two different Babylons: this is the same Babylon the great.
precepts.point: Thus shall they be unto thee with whom thou hast laboured, even thy merchants, from thy youth: they shall wander every one to his quarter; none shall save thee. Everyone goes back to their homeland.
precepts.why:
Isaiah tells the virgin daughter of Babylon, “Stand now with thine enchantments, and with the multitude of thy sorceries, wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth.” God is telling you straight that this Babylon deals in witchcraft. Some might think they are clever and say there are two different Babylons. No: Revelation 18 shows it is the same Babylon the great.

“And a mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone, and cast it into the sea, saying, Thus with violence shall that great city Babylon be thrown down, and shall be found no more at all.” That is the same end Isaiah gives: “desolation shall come upon thee suddenly.”

“And the light of a candle shall shine no more at all in thee; and the voice of the bridegroom and of the bride shall be heard no more at all in thee: for thy merchants were the great men of the earth.” The merchants are their corporations, the same merchants Isaiah names: “even thy merchants, from thy youth: they shall wander every one to his quarter; none shall save thee.”

“for by thy sorceries were all nations deceived.” By her sorceries all nations were deceived. That is imagery: what they put out in television and movies to manipulate the people, the way the Huxtables were an example. A film about the young George Washington dropped in theaters just this week, and it is not a coincidence: they want to bring the patriot spirit back for the 250th anniversary. It is witchcraft.

And she has laboured in it from her youth: 1776 is her youth, one of the youngest nations on the planet, with Washington DC laid out by the Freemasons in an upside down pentagram, the White House at the bottom point. That is the star some of our people wear while barbecuing on the Fourth of July, and they should be ashamed. Her astrologers and stargazers “shall be as stubble; the fire shall burn them”, and Babylon is thrown down with violence.

precepts.text: Remember the former things of old: for I am God, and there is none else; I am God, and there is none like me. Babylon says the exact same words God says of himself: I am, and none else beside me. A nation putting itself in the seat of God is blasphemy. And believing that your people can never rule themselves, that the world cannot run without your oppressor, is the same blasphemy: saying what God made cannot do what God promised.
precepts.point: Thou hast trusted in thy wickedness: thou hast said, None seeth me. That is the intelligence agencies destabilizing countries and neutralizing leaders in the dark. Thou art wearied in the multitude of thy counsels: the think tanks. Let now the astrologers, the stargazers, the monthly prognosticators, stand up, and save thee. Behold, they shall be as stubble; the fire shall burn them; they shall not deliver themselves from the power of the flame.

note.label: Blasphemers & Traitors: Judge Not Before the Time

precepts.why:
Babylon, “given to pleasures”, that “dwellest carelessly”, says in her heart, “I am, and none else beside me.” Where does she get that from? Isaiah 46 shows it: “Remember the former things of old: for I am God, and there is none else; I am God, and there is none like me.”

That is what God says of himself, and Babylon says the exact same thing. America puts herself in the seat of God. You are a man, but if you want I will make you a woman; I can fix that, I made that happen. America is the land of entitlement and privilege. She does what she wants to others and to her own people: passes laws secretly, changes laws, raises prices and brings them down, puts people in office who do not belong there. She dwells carelessly, and she makes her citizens care less, read less, think less and do less.

That is blasphemy from Babylon’s mouth and actions. And our people share in it, because they cannot see a world without the white man ruling the planet. They say he has to be saved, because they cannot see Negroes ever ruling the earth; we can’t rule over ourselves without him. That is blasphemy, an insult to God: saying what God made cannot rule over its own people. You are in hell trying to give your oppressor a heaven.

But God alone is God, and the one who says “I am” in his place is brought down: “Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon, sit on the ground: there is no throne.” The loss of children and widowhood come upon her “in a moment in one day”, “in their perfection”, every missile hitting its target as God intends, and her astrologers and prognosticators “shall be as stubble; the fire shall burn them.”

precepts.text: I will take vengeance, and I will not meet thee as a man: Christ is coming back with that immortal body. You will not be able to nail him back to the cross like you did in Jerusalem. That is what the fine linen, white and clean, is making reference to.
precepts.point: And I saw the beast, and the kings of the earth, and their armies, gathered together to make war against him that sat on the horse, and against his army. There it is: gathered together, minds already persuaded. And the beast was taken, and with him the false prophet, and these both were cast alive into a lake of fire burning with brimstone.

note.label: Popular Persuasions: Fighting Against Heaven Defending Earth

precepts.why:
The armies in heaven follow Christ “upon white horses, clothed in fine linen, white and clean.” That fine linen, white and clean, is the immortal body. To prove it, go to Isaiah, speaking to Babylon: “Thy nakedness shall be uncovered, yea, thy shame shall be seen: I will take vengeance, and I will not meet thee as a man.”

Christ said he is going to take vengeance, and he will not meet Babylon as a man. Christ is coming back with that immortal body. You will not be able to nail him back to the cross like you did in Jerusalem.

That is what the white horse and the fine linen, white and clean, make reference to. And he comes to make war, because God is a man of war: “in righteousness he doth judge and make war.” His vesture is dipped in blood, because there is going to be a lot of bloodshed, a lot of killing. On his head are many crowns, because he is going to take everyone's crowns and be the one King, “KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS.”

precepts.text: Come down and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon. America has never been touched, so she is the virgin; 9/11 was a controlled demolition. Now uncover the locks and make bare the leg: her nakedness is being uncovered as she allies with the little Satan and bombs other nations.
precepts.point: But rather that ye may prophesy. That is why the class deals with prophecy first. A captain adds that the purpose of prophecy is to build your spirit and prepare you for temptation and destruction; when you see these things come to pass, know that Esau, Edom, America, is the enemy the Bible speaks of.

note.label: Mindset Of A Leader, Actions Of A King

precepts.why:
“Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon, sit on the ground: there is no throne, O daughter of the Chaldeans”. The virgin daughter of Babylon is America. People try to say Babylon is somewhere else, but when has America been touched? The one thing that ever happened, they blew up themselves: 9/11 was the biggest controlled demolition anybody has ever witnessed. The virgin means she has not been touched, defiled or destroyed, until these prophecies are fulfilled. She is going to be touched.

“for thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate”. She thought she was tender and delicate, but that is coming to an end. As Daniel 2 showed, all manner of nations are within her, including her enemies: sleeper cells.

“Take the millstones, and grind meal: uncover thy locks, make bare the leg, uncover the thigh, pass over the rivers.” A virgin would be covered, but here her locks, leg and thigh are uncovered: the wickedness of Babylon, America, is being revealed.

“Thy nakedness shall be uncovered, yea, thy shame shall be seen: I will take vengeance, and I will not meet thee as a man.” What shame? How she allies herself with the little Satan and helps them bomb other countries, backing a demolition project to wipe out Gaza and its people, even renaming a whole body of water the Gulf of America. That is why the nations that benefited from her will grow to hate her, and prophecy lets us see it coming.

precepts.text: Before the flowers were seen, before the powers were established, before the multitude of angels were gathered, before the measures of the firmament were named: then did I consider these things, and they all were made through me alone, and through none other; by me also they shall be ended, and by none other. That is the mind of the Most High, and he sends Christ when he is ready.
precepts.point: When the planets line up and he sends Christ and the angels, you cannot stop it, and if you are not ready it comes as a thief in the night.

note.label: The Vantage Point of the Elders: the Fathers Have Spoken

precepts.why:
We say give the Lord no rest, make the time short, bring it on: when is he coming to get us out? We are trying to speed the Lord up. But the Lord has his timetable and a reason for the pace he is moving at, and when it is time for him to move, you can't stop it. Esau won't be able to stop it. “Therefore shall evil come upon thee; thou shalt not know from whence it riseth: and mischief shall fall upon thee; thou shalt not be able to put it off.” When all the planets have lined up, it is time to send Christ and the destroying angels to bring his people home, and if you are not ready, he comes as a thief in the night.

Ezra shows the mind of the Most High, his vantage point: “Before the fair flowers were seen, or ever the moveable powers were established, before the innumerable multitude of angels were gathered together, Or ever the heights of the air were lifted up, before the measures of the firmament were named, or ever the chimneys in Sion were hot” … “before they were sealed that have gathered faith for a treasure.”

“Then did I consider these things, and they all were made through me alone, and through none other: by me also they shall be ended, and by none other.” The Most High made all of that, so we can't question that kind of understanding. We are not on the level to question how the Lord did things. Nobody did this but him, and by him alone it shall be ended.

So he sends Christ when he is ready to send Christ. We don't know the day or the hour, but we know we are in the season, and the enemies of the Lord include some of our own people siding with the oppressors by agreeing to be in sin and destroying their own people. That is not the agencies; that is negroes being wicked as hell, and negro is a mind state across all twelve tribes that was never supposed to be you. Knowing these things are coming, we need to get our minds and our spirits right.

precepts.text: Who hath directed the Spirit of the Lord, or being his counsellor hath taught him? With whom took he counsel, and who instructed him in the path of judgment? Nobody; God is the knowledge. Having cleared the deck with questions you cannot answer, he proclaims: the nations are as a drop of a bucket, a drop you never notice fall from the pail, and counted as the small dust of the balance; he taketh up the isles as a very little thing; Lebanon is not sufficient to burn, nor its beasts sufficient for a burnt offering for him to accept Ishmael as his people. All nations before him are as nothing, and are counted to him less than nothing, spit, and vanity, while the first verse says comfort ye my people. 2 Esdras 6:55-56 parallels it with spittle.
precepts.point: When the planets line up and he sends Christ and the angels, you cannot stop it, and if you are not ready it comes as a thief in the night.

note.label: The Vantage Point of the Elders: the Fathers Have Spoken

precepts.why:
God's vantage point is far beyond the vantage point we think we have. People try to tell the Lord what to do: you can't love Jacob, you can't hate Esau, you can't forgive this one. So the Lord clears the deck and lets everybody know where he stands, and everybody else needs to shut the hell up.

“Who hath directed the Spirit of the Lord, or being his counsellor hath taught him?” Nobody. These are questions for us who are trying to push him. The dumb Christian talks about the way the Lord should be; shut up. “With whom took he counsel, and who instructed him, and taught him in the path of judgment, and taught him knowledge, and shewed to him the way of understanding?” Who taught God knowledge? Nobody. God is the knowledge; how are you going to teach him?

Having asked questions we can't answer, he proclaims what it is: “Behold, the nations are as a drop of a bucket.” You walk with a pail of water and one drop falls out; you won't even notice it. All the nations put together are that one drop. They “are counted as the small dust of the balance”: not big dust, small dust on the scales, weighing nothing. “He taketh up the isles as a very little thing”: the Polynesian and Hawaiian islands, very little, nothing.

“And Lebanon is not sufficient to burn, nor the beasts thereof sufficient for a burnt offering.” If they burnt up all the meat in Lebanon, it would not be sufficient for him to accept the Arabs, Ishmael, as his people. Only the Israelites are his people; that is why the first verse of the chapter says, comfort ye my people.

“All nations before him are as nothing; and they are counted to him less than nothing, and vanity.” Less than nothing is spit, a bowel movement. That is how the nations are counted to God, while to us he says comfort ye my people. That is the difference, and nobody can say anything against it. 2 Esdras 6:55-56 parallels it and calls them spittle: Ezra was quoting Isaiah. The supreme power has it set up the way he wants it set up.

precepts.text: Stand now with thine enchantments... if so be thou mayest prevail. No sorcery or weapon can stop what God has written.
precepts.point: Enchantment means magic, sorcery, hypnotism and spells. The magicians of Egypt are today's scientists.
precepts.why:
Babylon's destruction comes “in a moment in one day”, and the Lord gives the reason: “for the multitude of thy sorceries, and for the great abundance of thine enchantments.” There was sorcery used upon our people in America, and then America used that same thing on all the nations.

That is why your uncle and your auntie won't repent after you accepted Christianity. That is witchcraft, used to keep you in the state of mind you are in. It is the pattern of every captivity: from the Assyrian captivity to the Babylonian, from the Medes and the Persians to the Greeks and to Rome, and now we are in America. All the nations have always used enchantments and witchcraft against us to keep us in darkness, and Satan is dealing with them.

The word enchantment means magic, witchcraft, sorcery, wizardry, necromancy, conjuration, hypnotism, mesmerism, voodoo, charms, spells, incantations, mojo. Remember coming out of Egypt, when the magicians were doing their things? Those magicians are who call themselves scientists today, with different titles under that name. They are the witches of this earth. Hypnotism is like the movie Get Out: our people have been sinking, and it is time to help them come out. America did not use only words against us. It used every witchcraft and every voodoo it could find, and the Catholic church is part of that foolishness.

Then the Lord dares them: “Stand now with thine enchantments, and with the multitude of thy sorceries, wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth.” America has been dealing with the devil from its youth up. “If so be thou shalt be able to profit, if so be thou mayest prevail.” The Lord is saying: since you have practiced these things from your youth, let me see if you will prevail against me. Let me see if that little nuke, that robot that is half a man, all that witchcraft and all the media you have through the earth, can stop what I am bringing into this earth.

We saw it when America was trying to attack and the Lord raised up a storm that destroyed helicopters and airplanes. They don't understand the prophecy. These things are already written, and no man can change them. The nuclear weapons every nation holds are not going to sit on a shelf like extra paint; an ICBM can reach Washington in under half an hour, and what Isaiah and Jeremiah spoke of exists in our time.

That is why we are out here teaching and telling our people to repent. We see what is coming. The same way God destroyed the first world with a flood, he is going to destroy this world with fire, and no sorcery or weapon can stop what God has written.

precepts.text: Alas, alas that great city Babylon! for in one hour is thy judgment come.
precepts.point: Loss of children and widowhood shall come in one day for the multitude of thy sorceries. Thy wisdom and knowledge have perverted thee, and thou hast said, I am.

note.label: Donald Trump: the Sword of God

precepts.why:
“Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon.” Babylon, America, is up on high, a proud nation, and God says he will bring her down. “thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate”, because the prophets will be revealing this devil to his face on the streets, and the world is going to know this is the man of sin, the son of perdition. “uncover thy locks, make bare the leg, uncover the thigh”: take off that head covering; you are no righteous woman, you are a hoe. “Thy nakedness shall be uncovered, yea, thy shame shall be seen: I will take vengeance.”

“But these two things shall come to thee in a moment in one day, the loss of children, and widowhood.” Death and fire are coming to Babylon, “for the multitude of thy sorceries”: the evil America perpetrates throughout the earth, the LGBT, the murder, the colonization, the imperialism, the genocides.

Is “in one day” read elsewhere? Revelation 18: “Standing afar off for the fear of her torment, saying, Alas, alas, that great city Babylon, that mighty city! for in one hour is thy judgment come.” That great city Babylon is America, that mighty city no other nation could defeat. In one hour, in one day, her judgment comes.

That one-hour judgment is coming for America. What are you going to do about it? Are you going to survive it? Are you going to put in the work, change your life and repent, or keep playing games because you think you have a little more time?

precepts.text: The Lord shall punish the host of the high ones and the kings of the earth upon the earth.
precepts.point: Loss of children and widowhood shall come in one day for the multitude of thy sorceries. Thy wisdom and knowledge have perverted thee, and thou hast said, I am.

note.label: Donald Trump: the Sword of God

precepts.why:
The virgin daughter of Babylon says, “I am, and none else beside me”: I am the one, not the French, not the Arabs; big bad America; my military is in all countries and nobody can do a thing about it. “Thy wisdom and thy knowledge, it hath perverted thee”: your science, technology and weaponry have perverted you, and now all you do is drop bombs from drones. “Therefore shall evil come upon thee; thou shalt not know from whence it riseth”, “and desolation shall come upon thee suddenly.”

Isaiah 24 shows who else is judged with her: “And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth.”

The high ones that are on high are Esau in his pride. And with him the kings of the earth, the other nations upon the earth. All nations will be punished, and there is not a thing they can do about it. If the Israelites got punished, why would you not get punished? You have to be punished too.

So Babylon coming down to sit in the dust is part of that day. The Lord brings down the proud one on high first, and the judgment reaches all the kings of the earth.

precepts.text: Thou that art given to pleasures, that sayest in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me.
precepts.point: It was given him to make war with the saints and overcome them; the nations worship the white man even in congregations where everyone looks like them.
precepts.why:
“All the world wondered after the beast”, and “they worshipped the dragon which gave power unto the beast”. The devil himself gives power to the beast, the white man. And they say, “Who is like unto the beast? who is able to make war with him?” Who is like the beast, created for the perfection of warfare? That is Space Command moving to Huntsville, Alabama, to be called Rocket City; that is DARPA, the most powerful portion of Esau’s military, always twenty years ahead of anything you or I know; that is the Department of Defense renamed the Department of War. They understand how much a name matters, just as we should understand how important the name of Israel is.

Isaiah 47 shows the heart of that beast: “thou that art given to pleasures, that dwellest carelessly, that sayest in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me”. This place is given to pleasures and dwells carelessly, as if no one can take her down. “I shall not sit as a widow, neither shall I know the loss of children”: no one can cause them to lose lives.

Jump to verse 10: “For thou hast trusted in thy wickedness: thou hast said, None seeth me. Thy wisdom and thy knowledge, it hath perverted thee”. They trust in their wickedness, and they say it again, “I am, and none else beside me.”

Ezekiel 28 gives the answer: “Because thou hast set thine heart as the heart of God; Behold, therefore I will bring strangers upon thee, the terrible of the nations”. The world asks who is able to make war with the beast; the Lord says the terrible of the nations shall come upon them.

precepts.text: Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom; O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed.
precepts.point: Take the millstones and grind meal: she will be enslaved as Samson ground in the prison house. Her nakedness shall be uncovered, and God will not meet her as a man.
precepts.why:
Who is the virgin daughter of Babylon? Let's identify her. “Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.” Destroy it, destroy it. Then, speaking to the same people: “O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed”. Edom is now called the daughter of Babylon, and she is destined to be destroyed.

So Isaiah 47 is the destruction of Babylon, which is Edom, the very thing David said in the psalm. “Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon, sit on the ground”: you have been taken down, defeated. Then “there is no throne”: your throne is finished, your throne is over.

Then, “for thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate.” Babylon calls herself tender and delicate. How? The United States of America says, we are a Christian nation. She has two horns like a lamb, Republicans and Democrats, and says, we are Christian, in God we trust. That is the tender and delicate virgin, and God says she will be called that no more.

The children of Edom who cried to raze Jerusalem to its foundation are the daughter of Babylon today, America, and she is the one who is to be destroyed.

precepts.text: The Philistines put out Samson's eyes, and he did grind in the prison house.
precepts.point: Take the millstones and grind meal: she will be enslaved as Samson ground in the prison house. Her nakedness shall be uncovered, and God will not meet her as a man.
precepts.why:
Isaiah tells the daughter of Babylon, “Take the millstones, and grind meal”. What does that mean? When you take millstones and grind meal, you are working. But what kind of work? Look at what happened to Samson.

Samson listened to that woman called Delilah, who got paid to take his strength and destroy this mighty black man. She was a black woman, not an Israelite but a Hamite, a good-looking Hamite, and she gave it to him so good that he told her his secrets and went to sleep on her knees. The Philistines came in, cut his hair, bound him up and took his eyes out: “But the Philistines took him, and put out his eyes, and brought him down to Gaza, and bound him with fetters of brass; and he did grind in the prison house.”

When it says they made him grind, they made him work. That is slavery. Even when you go to prison they make you work, and that is still slavery: look up the 13th Amendment.

So this is what God is saying to America, to these Europeans, these Caucasians: take the millstones and grind meal. Get ready for slavery. Then “uncover thy locks, make bare the leg, uncover the thigh, pass over the rivers.” As a tender and delicate virgin her head was covered; God says uncover it, lift the dress to the calf, then to the thigh. The rivers she passes over are the word of God, “the washing of water by the word”. America says, I am a virgin daughter, a Christian nation, and the prophets open the word of God and show she is not, revealing her wickedness.

precepts.text: The ten horns shall hate the whore, make her desolate and naked, and burn her with fire.
precepts.point: Take the millstones and grind meal: she will be enslaved as Samson ground in the prison house. Her nakedness shall be uncovered, and God will not meet her as a man.
precepts.why:
“Thy nakedness shall be uncovered, yea, thy shame shall be seen: I will take vengeance, and I will not meet thee as a man.” How is America's nakedness uncovered? Through the prophets: the brothers on the streets, on YouTube, traveling, must uncover America's nakedness and reveal her wickedness. And Christ is not coming back as a man; he is coming back as God, because only a God can take down the United States of America. Russia can't do it, China can't do it. America has bases all over the world, and no other nation has that power.

Revelation 17 shows what happens to America and her allies: “And the ten horns which thou sawest upon the beast, these shall hate the whore, and shall make her desolate and naked, and shall eat her flesh, and burn her with fire.” The ten horns on the beast with seven heads are NATO, the EU. They shall hate America, make her desolate and naked, eat her flesh, and burn her with fire. That is the United States of America burnt up and destroyed.

Is America finished then? The party ain't over. 2 Esdras 15 says, “And in the passage they shall rush on the idle city, and shall destroy some portion of thy land, and consume part of thy glory, and shall return to Babylon that was destroyed.” Not all of her is destroyed in that war. The country as we know it is finished, but America is not down yet, with all those bases everywhere.

That is why Isaiah says “I will not meet thee as a man.” The ten horns can make her naked and burn her, but the only one that can finally destroy America is God, Christ when he returns.

precepts.text: Even for this same purpose have I raised thee up, that I might shew my power in thee.
precepts.point: Take the millstones and grind meal: she will be enslaved as Samson ground in the prison house. Her nakedness shall be uncovered, and God will not meet her as a man.
precepts.why:
The only one that can destroy America is Christ when he returns, and Romans 9 shows why God raised her up at all: “For the scripture saith unto Pharaoh, Even for this same purpose have I raised thee up, that I might shew my power in thee, and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth.”

Pharaoh was over Egypt, and Egypt has long been destroyed. Pharaoh is a metaphor for Rome, and a metaphor for America today. Revelation calls the great city spiritually Sodom and Egypt, and that is Pharaoh right there.

God raised America up. Why? That he might show his power in her. All the technological advances America has, God allowed her to have. There is no nation, no country, that can match Babylon the Great; that is why they call it the great: it has the greatest technology of all nations. Christ says, I must show my power in you, because I am the only one that can take America out.

Then “and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth.” When Christ finally takes them down, his name shall be declared throughout all the earth, because we are going to declare his real name, his true name. That is the vengeance of Isaiah 47: “I will take vengeance, and I will not meet thee as a man.”

precepts.text: He shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck until he have destroyed thee.
precepts.point: God polluted Israel with man-made religions founded in America after slavery.
precepts.why:
“I was wroth with my people”: wroth means angry. The pictures of our people in slavery, beaten, on the slave ships, lynched, murdered from the time of slavery all the way up to now, are God being wroth with his people. It is like a family album of our family. He allowed the white man to beat the hell out of us, and we were made slaves for the white man.

Deuteronomy 28:48 is what that anger looked like: “he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.” Think about the mindset of the brother in those conditions, with the big yoke of iron on his neck and in the different positions of slavery. Your mind is going to go crazy, because you know you are not supposed to be in that situation. That is what those torture devices were set to do.

“until he have destroyed thee” means until your mind breaks down, until your manhood is gone and your ability to be free is gone. When you just succumb to being a slave, your mental strength and fortitude to be independent is broken. That is what black people are today.

So Isaiah 47:6 says the same: “thou didst shew them no mercy; upon the ancient hast thou very heavily laid thy yoke.” This Christian nation, as they say, showed us no mercy, and laid the yoke heavy even on the oldest among us. And she said “I shall be a lady for ever”, I will be Christian forever, and did not lay these things to heart, “neither didst remember the latter end of it”, though they have the Bible and know what it says will happen at the latter end.

precepts.text: Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men.
precepts.point: God polluted Israel with man-made religions founded in America after slavery.
precepts.why:
“I have polluted mine inheritance.” How did God pollute his people? With man-made religions. Paul warns: “Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ.” None of these religions are after Christ.

Look at where they came from. Pope Nicholas V, the father of the transatlantic slave trade, and after the popes the Protestants. John Smith created the Baptist religion. Joseph Smith created the Mormon religion in 1830. Ellen G. White created the Seventh-day Adventist religion in 1863. Charles T. Russell created the Jehovah's Witness religion in 1872. Charles Parham created the Pentecostal religion in 1901.

These run from slavery up to 1863, when we so-called got emancipated, and on through Jim Crow and segregation. The same people who held us as slaves handed us these religions. What happened to John 3:16 and Galatians 3:28 while our people were in chains? They took that out of the Bible at that time.

So Isaiah 47:6 shows God allowed us to be polluted: “I was wroth with my people, I have polluted mine inheritance, and given them into thine hand.” The traditions of men that spoiled our people are part of that pollution, and that is why Christ is the enemy of Christianity.

precepts.text: The well-favoured harlot, the mistress of witchcrafts, that selleth nations through her whoredoms.
precepts.point: Thou hast said, none seeth me; thy wisdom and thy knowledge hath perverted thee. Desolation shall come suddenly.
precepts.why:
“Therefore hear now this, thou that art given to pleasures, that dwellest carelessly.” Given to pleasures: Lifestyles of the Rich and Famous, champagne wishes and caviar dreams, and it made negroes jealous and envious. “that sayest in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me.” Only the Most High can say I am; they are setting themselves up as God on earth. “I shall not sit as a widow”: I will always have my allies. “neither shall I know the loss of children”: my citizens will not die. “But these two things shall come to thee in a moment in one day, the loss of children, and widowhood”: their citizens put to death, and their allies cutting them loose, “for the multitude of thy sorceries.” Their science and technology, like the mystery weapon that left Venezuelan soldiers bleeding through the nose, God calls witchcraft.

Nahum names her: “Because of the multitude of the whoredoms of the wellfavoured harlot, the mistress of witchcrafts, that selleth nations through her whoredoms, and families through her witchcrafts.” The well-favoured harlot is the same whore of Revelation 17, America, the same virgin daughter of Babylon. She is well-favoured because this is Babylon the great: everybody wants to come here; everybody says, I can get rich there.

She is called the mistress of witchcrafts. And in case you did not think it was America: “that selleth nations.” What nations did America sell? The nation of Judah and the nation of Israel, the two kingdoms, sold into slavery. “and families through her witchcrafts”: did they not sell our families? You had better believe they did.

So the one given to pleasures who says I am, and none else beside me, is the harlot of Nahum. Her sorceries, labored in “from thy youth” since July 4th, 1776, are the reason the loss of children and widowhood will come upon her in one day.

precepts.text: The heavens and the earth which are now are reserved unto fire against the day of judgment.
precepts.point: They shall be as stubble, and the fire shall burn them; there shall not be a coal to warm at.
precepts.why:
“Stand now with thine enchantments, and with the multitude of thy sorceries, wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth.” God is saying, Stand still and use your science, your sorcery, your technology. “Let now the astrologers, the stargazers, the monthly prognosticators, stand up, and save thee”: their generals, admirals and scientists who examine the stars, set up the golden dome and create this missile and that missile. “Behold, they shall be as stubble; the fire shall burn them”: burnt up, destroyed, by nuclear fire, by God’s fire. “there shall not be a coal to warm at, nor fire to sit before it”: no comfort for Babylon.

Peter shows that fire: “But the heavens and the earth, which are now, by the same word are kept in store, reserved unto fire against the day of judgment and perdition of ungodly men.” This heaven and this earth are reserved unto fire, and the perdition of ungodly men is Christianity and whatever other little religions are here.

The scoffers say, “Where is the promise of his coming? for since the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.” They purposely ignore the flood of Genesis 6, when God killed everybody on the planet except eight people: “For this they willingly are ignorant of.” That world perished because of the evils of Cain and his seed.

“But, beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years.” The beloved is Israel: he “hath given it unto Jacob his servant, and to Israel his beloved.” It has been over three thousand years since the flood, and they say it will never happen again. But “the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night”, “and the elements shall melt with fervent heat.” That is the destiny of America and all nations.

“what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness”: our conversation must change. We see the signs, rivers dried up, presidents being stolen. We look for new heavens and a new earth wherein dwelleth righteousness, the twelve tribes of Israel under Christ, and we must be found of him in peace, without spot and blameless.

precepts.text: I will shew the nations thy nakedness, and the kingdoms thy shame.
precepts.point: Thou hast trusted in thy wickedness and said, none seeth me; evil shall come upon thee, and thou shalt not know from whence it riseth.
precepts.why:
“Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon, sit on the ground: there is no throne.” That is Esau: no more throne, no more power. She calls herself a virgin, and Nahum shows what she really is.

“Woe to the bloody city! it is all full of lies and robbery.” This is the bloody city right here. America is full of lies and robbery: they rob all the nations, and everything that comes out of their mouth is a lie. “Because of the multitude of the whoredoms of the wellfavoured harlot, the mistress of witchcrafts, that selleth nations through her whoredoms, and families through her witchcrafts.” America is that harlot. She destroys families and destroys nations and calls it democracy, bringing freedom, yet does not follow it herself. She sanctions the International Court of Justice when it brings charges against Netanyahu; that court was made to judge the black nations. The white man is above the law.

“Behold, I am against thee, saith the Lord of hosts; and I will discover thy skirts upon thy face.” God is against this place. He is going to discover America’s skirts and reveal her wickedness: America is not a virgin, she is a hoe who has been sleeping with everybody. “and I will shew the nations thy nakedness, and the kingdoms thy shame.” He is going to show the whole world how evil this place is.

For centuries they murdered, killed and robbed with no cameras, and said, “None seeth me.” Now social media records it and people see the evil in Venezuela, and still they look at the camera and say that is not what happened. The virgin daughter of Babylon who says none seeth me will have her nakedness uncovered before the nations, and through that, our deliverance and our salvation are coming.

precepts.text: I will take vengeance, and I will not meet thee as a man; at his second coming Christ comes with the power of the living God.
precepts.point: The captain of the host of the Lord is Christ, the captain of our salvation. This is why Joshua was afraid: the return of Christ is not the soft picture Christianity paints, for he is not coming back made like unto his brethren as at the first, but with the power of the living God, to take vengeance and destroy. No missiles or fighter jets will do anything against him.

note.label: Joshua 5: Circumcision of the Flesh and of the Heart

precepts.why:
Joshua was afraid of the captain of the host, and he had reason. “Thy nakedness shall be uncovered, yea, thy shame shall be seen: I will take vengeance, and I will not meet thee as a man.” The return of Christ is not the soft picture Christianity paints. He is not coming back made like unto his brethren as at the first, but with the power of the living God, to take vengeance and destroy.

I will not meet thee as a man: no missiles or fighter jets will do anything against him. The man with his sword drawn by Jericho is that same captain.

precepts.text: Come down and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon (America); she says in her heart "I am, and none beside me," yet her nakedness shall be uncovered.
precepts.point: He says in his heart, "I shall never be in adversity." This is Esau saying his kingdom will last forever, naming America and Africa and the European countries after his ancestors.

note.label: Psalm 10: Why Standest Thou Afar Off, O Lord

precepts.why:
“He hath said in his heart, I shall not be moved: for I shall never be in adversity.” This is Esau saying his kingdom will last forever, naming America and Africa and the European countries after his ancestors.

Isaiah heard the same boast from the virgin daughter of Babylon, which is America, and answered it: “Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon, sit on the ground: there is no throne, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate.” She is told, “Take the millstones, and grind meal: uncover thy locks, make bare the leg, uncover the thigh, pass over the rivers. Thy nakedness shall be uncovered, yea, thy shame shall be seen: I will take vengeance, and I will not meet thee as a man.” And the one doing it: “As for our redeemer, the Lord of hosts is his name, the Holy One of Israel.”

God says why: “I was wroth with my people, I have polluted mine inheritance, and given them into thine hand: thou didst shew them no mercy; upon the ancient hast thou very heavily laid thy yoke. And thou saidst, I shall be a lady for ever: so that thou didst not lay these things to thy heart, neither didst remember the latter end of it.” She was given Israel to hold, showed no mercy, and said she would be a lady for ever, never remembering the latter end.

Then the very words of the wicked in Psalm 10: “thou that art given to pleasures, that dwellest carelessly, that sayest in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me; I shall not sit as a widow, neither shall I know the loss of children”. She says in her heart, I am, and none beside me, yet her nakedness shall be uncovered. Through the pride of his countenance the wicked will not seek after God; he is thinking about money and how to destroy the Israelites and keep his kingdom going, not knowing he is only fulfilling the prophecy God said he would.
